claims.statement: Tom Allen was said to be sick at the time of the recent meeting for drawing up the articles of his fight with Mike McCoole.
claims.excerpt: He was said te be sick at the time.

claims.statement: Tom Allen had a match made with Mike McCoole, with the articles being drawn up in July 1869.
claims.excerpt: tbe match now meade between myseif and r. McCoole.

claims.statement: Tom Allen challenged Charley Gallagher to fight him for $500, apart from his McCoole match, in one day, one week or one month.

claims.statement: Tom Allen deposited $100 with his backer, Billy Carroll, at 510 Market Street, for Gallagher to cover.
claims.excerpt: him cover $100 which F have deposited with my backer, Buly Carroll

quotes.speaker: Tom Allen
quotes.text: Words are cheap, but money tatks.

fights.notes: Rematch articles drawn up; the letter gives no date for the fight.

notes: The letter is dated 11 July 1869. 'pvof present' is garbled in the OCR; the sickness is 'said' by the paper, so medium confidence. Allen is reported present at the preliminaries in another article, which may be a different meeting.
